text: Implemented the versioned executable EyeLink v0.6 support contract in EyeLinkSupport.scala, the task-first format card in docs/formats/eyelink-asc.md, and six contract/type tests. The matrix separates release disposition from current evidence so planned rows cannot be advertised as validated; binary EDF is explicitly rejected at the portable boundary; GAZE is a materialization obligation while HREF/RAW are preserved without pixel relabelling; all eye layouts, 250/500/1000/2000 Hz, 1000 family, Portable Duo, and EyeLink 3 have named planned evidence. Design is grounded in SR Research ASC File Analysis, EyeLink Data Types, File Data Control, and EDF2ASC guidance. Focused ioJVM and ioJS suites passed 6/6 each; scalafmtCheckAll passed. Mutation receipt: replacing planned evidence references with Vector.empty made the named evidence-contract test fail at EyeLinkSupportSuite.scala:32; implementation was restored and JVM suite returned 6/6.
